body:
## Why

A refreshed generated dev-tool PR in this repository fails the required Gate Compose smoke job before any project tests run. The generated PR is source-owned and must not be patched to hide a repo-local dependency problem.

## Scope

Repair the repository-owned dependency/runtime contract used by Compose smoke so the test dependency install is reproducible on its configured Python runtime. Current exact evidence: learning-management-system#720 head 09966ae1aedf53d0ca5ceacc888276d8c97af48f, Gate run 36055256246, Compose smoke job 107820572921. The job uses Python 3.14.7 and uv; while building sqlalchemy==2.1.0 from sdist, uv rejects its pyproject.toml at line 45 with duplicate normalized extra name mssql-pymssql. The log says sqlalchemy is included because lms depends on it. Determine whether a compatible SQLAlchemy version/wheel or a supported CI runtime is the correct repo-local fix. Keep production dependency policy intact and document the chosen constraint.

## Non-Goals

Do not edit the generated dev-tool PR or Workflows-managed consumer files. Do not suppress Compose smoke or mark the failing check optional. Do not force-install an invalid package.

## Tasks

- [ ] Reproduce the Python 3.14.7 uv install failure from the current Compose smoke dependency set and identify the repository-owned declaration selecting sqlalchemy==2.1.0.
- [ ] Apply the narrowest supported repository-local dependency or runtime repair, with a regression test or lock/metadata assertion preventing recurrence.
- [ ] Run the focused install and Compose smoke validation on the repaired branch.
- [ ] Merge through normal exact-head CI and review gates, then let Maint 52 regenerate the dev-tool delivery if its base changed.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The repository-owned repair removes the duplicate-normalized-extra installation failure on the configured Compose smoke runtime without skipping the job.
- [ ] Focused install and Compose smoke checks pass on the repaired source PR.
- [ ] The generated dev-tool PR remains unmodified by this issue work and can be refreshed through its owning workflow.

## Implementation Notes

Source log: https://github.com/stranske/learning-management-system/actions/runs/36055256246/job/107820572921 . Failure excerpt: Failed to parse sqlalchemy==2.1.0 sdist pyproject.toml; duplicate normalized extra name mssql-pymssql. The source-owned sync campaign is tracked at stranske/Workflows#1836.
title: Fix Compose smoke SQLAlchemy 2.1.0 install failure on Python 3.14
